Efficient Training
Introduction
Training large models takes a significant amount of computing time, and most of it is spent
on d most of it ata that the model has already learned well. We show a simple schedule
that skips such examples and halves the cost while keeping the accuracy of the full run.
• Skip examples the model already knows.
• Keep a small sample of them for checking.
◦ Never skip the rare classes.
Method
1. Score every example.
2. Drop the easiest third.
3. Train on the rest.
